scope: All-cohort integrity and source checks only. Held-out data were not used for fitting, feature selection, cleaning choices or new predictive-performance estimates. Descriptive plots/outlier review use train records only.

noise_review.scope: Descriptive training-only review; no corruption diagnosis or cleaning/performance experiment.
noise_review.rule: Any |0.6744897501960817*(x-median)/MAD|>4.5 over4baseline deltas; train-only location and scale.
noise_review.interpretation: Generated random variation and injected events are intentional. Statistical extremeness is not an invalid-record label; new evidence of cleaning benefit requires separate evaluation.
